title: Yummy Jelly Dutch Ground Nut Oil Poffertjes
description: A festive Dutch dessert featuring ground nut oil, kombu-cold-extract, and a floral glassy-jelly topping.
instructions: Activate the agar agar powder by mixing it with 1/4 cup of cold water in a small bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix the rice flour and ground nut oil.
Add the kombu pieces and cold water to the rice flour mixture and stir until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in the rice flour mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the mixture forms a smooth, thick paste.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool.
Add the agar agar mixture, maple syrup, floral honey, and lemon juice to the cooled rice flour mixture.
Mix well until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and grease with vegan gelatin.
Drop the batter by spoonfuls onto the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Flip the poffertjes and cook for another 2 minutes.
Serve hot with a glassy-jelly topping made from the agar agar mixture and floral honey.
